Rechecked 2026-11-10: the newest build, 13.0.0-next.3, is still published by npm user webk1d with no attestations (12.12.1 carries SLSA provenance via GitHub Actions OIDC), so trustPolicy no-downgrade still rejects the 13.x line; 12.12.1 is still the newest 12.x. No upstream tag, changelog or migration guide for v13 exists. Recheck every sweep and move when a v13 build ships with provenance.
